description: This file contains utility functions for UI components such as form headers, module titles, and popup headers/footers in a SuiteCRM/SugarCRM environment. It also includes access control checks and file comments related to licensing.

classes.name: Sugar_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine class used for rendering templates within these utility functions.

classes.name: SugarView
classes.description: Class used for rendering views and UI components, includes methods like getBreadCrumbSymbol().

methods.name: get_form_header
methods.description: Generates HTML for a styled form header with optional help and print links.

methods.name: get_module_title
methods.description: Creates HTML for a module title with optional create button, including icon handling.

methods.name: getClassicModuleTitle
methods.description: Builds HTML for a classic view module title section, configurable with breadcrumbs and create links.

methods.name: insert_popup_header
methods.description: Outputs HTML for the beginning of a popup header, including CSS, scripts, and meta tags.

methods.name: insert_popup_footer
methods.description: Outputs HTML for the closing tags of a popup footer.
